title: Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) Devices for Obstructive Sleep Apnea
description: Medicare local coverage determination for CPAP/APAP therapy in adult obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). Requires documented diagnostic polysomnography with AHI >= 15 events/hr or AHI 5-14 with documented comorbid hypertension, stroke, or excessive daytime sleepiness, and face-to-face clinical evaluation prior to sleep study.

criteria.name: Diagnostic Polysomnography (AHI/RDI)
criteria.description: Documented overnight diagnostic polysomnography demonstrating AHI or RDI >= 15 events/hr, or AHI 5-14 accompanied by documented comorbid symptoms (hypertension, excessive daytime sleepiness, stroke, ischemic heart disease).
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm objective sleep apnea severity meeting statutory threshold

criteria.name: Face-to-Face Clinical Evaluation
criteria.description: Documented in-person face-to-face clinical evaluation by prescribing clinician prior to the diagnostic sleep study.
